mapper.select: /* 고객별 통계 [6050] - 심사항목코드가 국가코드인 경우(~ Country Code, 건수) */ /* StatUserMapper.selectChartList */ /* 사용안함 */ SELECT ROWNUM AS NUM, A.* FROM ( SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT AS TITLE, COUNT(A.INPT_MST_SRNO) AS TOT_CNT, SUM(A.AI_INPT_BUY_AM) AS AI_INPT_BUY_AM FROM ( SELECT A.INPT_MST_SRNO, NVL(A.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT, A.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT) AS INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT, B.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD, C.XPBY_COL_AM AS AI_INPT_BUY_AM FROM CSPD004TF A, CSPD001TM B, ( SELECT FX_ACNO AS ACTL_FX_REFNO, XPO_CVRG_MK_SQ AS FX_REFNO_SRNO, XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD AS XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD, NVL(INPT_FAXC_AM, XPBY_COL_AM) AS XPBY_COL_AM, CUS_ENG_NM, CSNO FROM CSPD201TM WHERE CSNO = #{aiInptCsno} UNION ALL SELECT FX_ACNO AS ACTL_FX_REFNO, TDOC_RCP_SRNO AS FX_REFNO_SRNO, TDOC_RCP_CUCD AS XPBY_COL_CTR_CUCD, NVL(INPT_FAXC_AM, TDOC_RCP_AM) AS XPBY_COL_AM, CUS_ENG_NM, CSNO FROM CSPD202TM WHERE CSNO = #{aiInptCsno} ) C WHERE A.INPT_MST_SRNO = B.INPT_MST_SRNO AND B.ACTL_FX_REFNO = C.ACTL_FX_REFNO AND B.FX_REFNO_SRNO = C.FX_REFNO_SRNO AND A.INPT_SANCTION_NO = #{inptSanctionNo} AND B.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = #{inptAtmcBizDscd} AND B.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('160','140') AND B.INPT_RCP_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate}, '-', '') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate}, '-', '') AND NVL(A.ITM_INPT_HNDG_INP_DAT_TXT, A.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT) IS NOT NULL AND A.SAFEWATCH_ITM_YN = 'Y') A GROUP BY A.INPT_SANCTION_DAT_TXT) A WHERE A.TOT_CNT > 0 ORDER BY A.TOT_CNT DESC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= #{recordCountPerPage}
